questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code handles malformed or missing configuration values? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The deployment sets neither FCM_CREDENTIALS_PATH nor SMS_API_KEY. What does the service do at startup?
choices: It throws on the first missing variable, naming only SMS_GATEWAY_URL or whichever is checked first
It starts with empty credentials and fails on the first notification it sends
It collects every problem found, throws one ConfigException listing them, and Main exits with code 78 after printing the list
It falls back to defaults for both values and logs a warning

questions.prompt: QUIET_HOURS is left unset and the default '22-7' is used. How does QuietHours.contains treat hours 23 and 3?
choices: Both are inside quiet hours, because start > end is treated as a window that wraps past midnight
Neither is inside quiet hours, because 22 is greater than 7 and the range is empty
Only 23 is inside quiet hours; 3 is excluded because it is below the start hour
Both are rejected because parseQuietHours only accepts start less than end

questions.prompt: Why does ConfigLoader take an env: Map<String, String> constructor argument instead of calling System.getenv inside?
choices: So that the loader can be exercised with arbitrary maps in tests and the process environment is read in exactly one place, Main
Because Kotlin does not allow reading environment variables in a class
So that environment variables can be modified at runtime without restarting the service
